Coming to Atlanta

A Space Built to Match Your Ambition.

This is Annu Beauty Studios — a private, professional home for independent entrepreneurs across beauty, wellness, business, and ecommerce, designed from the ground up to feel like more than a rented room.

Every detail, from the finishes to the lighting, was chosen to reflect the caliber of the professionals who will work here.

More Than a Studio

Build Your Business While You Build Your Clientele.

At Annu Beauty Studios, we believe your workspace should do more than provide a place to serve clients — it should help you build a thriving business.

That's why every studio member receives a Complimentary Business Growth Consultation, designed to provide personalized guidance and help you uncover opportunities to grow with confidence.

Following your consultation, you'll have the opportunity to join our exclusive Business Hub Membership — an optional membership created for entrepreneurs who want continued support, education, accountability, and business development as they scale.

Because your success is our success.

Included with Every Suite

  • Complimentary Business Growth Consultation
  • Access to an Exclusive Entrepreneur Community
  • Opportunity to Join the Business Hub Membership — coaching, financial literacy, credit repair & marketing education

Meet the Founder

Ashayla Anu — Founder & CEO

Ashayla rented a suite in Atlanta as a loctician and rock stylist for years before she ever thought about owning the building. She knows exactly what suite rental is missing — the fees that aren't in the contract, the landlord who never asks how business is going, the isolation of building alone — because she lived it first.

So she built the thing she wished existed: a luxury studio space with real support behind it. Our mission is simple — give beauty, wellness, business, and ecommerce entrepreneurs an affordable, luxury environment where they can launch, run, and grow thriving businesses, without going it alone.

LuxuryAn elevated environment that reflects the caliber of your work.
CommunityGenuine connection and collaboration among tenants.
EmpowermentEquipping tenants with tools to run successful businesses.
GrowthSupporting brand, business, and client experience together.
